# addr name comment   (expressions allowed: names used as base-1 etc. are generated by ffdis)
80 RESETDB    reset switch debounce (bit7)
81 GSTATE     b0-1 game variant, b2 guards out (boss engaged), b3 fire latch, b5 attract playfield, b6 in play, b7 game started
82 FRAME      frame counter lo
83 FRAMEHI    frame counter hi
84 CYC3       1..3 cycle
85 PLAYER     b0-3 lives (bitmask), b4 facing left, b5 eat sound, b6 dying
86 POWER      power gauge ($FD+ = full, <6 = dead)
87 SCOREHI    BCD
88 SCORELO    BCD
89 HISCHI     BCD
8A HISCLO     BCD
8B PLXHI      player world X
8C PLXLO
8D BUBXHI     bubble world X
8E BUBXLO
8F CAMXHI     camera world X
90 CAMXLO
91 PARKX      off-screen / scenery X
92 PLHM       player HMxx|coarse
93 BOSSHM     boss block (ball) HM|coarse
94 PLY        player Y (grows upward, $0E-$71)
95 BUBY       bubble Y
96 TICK3      incremented every 3 frames
97 BUBST      bubble state: b7 active, b4 direction
98 BUBTMR     bubble lifetime
99 EATTMR     eat sound timer
9A DIETMR     death timer
B7 BOSSIDX    boss on screen (0-3) or $80
B9 PLANTNUS   NUSIZ for seaweed
BA SPAWNCNT   roaming enemy spawn counter
C9 GST        guard state x4: 0 empty, 1 swim, 2 fruit, 3 roamer, $80 parked
CD GX         guard X x4
D1 GY         guard Y x4
D5 GTMR       guard timer x4
D9 GLEFT      guards left per boss x4
DD BGLOW      boss glow timer (BCD) x4
E1 TMP1
E2 TMP2
E3 TMP3
E4 TMP4
E9 DIGBUF     10-byte digit/sprite buffer
